archetypes.name: tally-correctness
archetypes.rationale: Bonus eligibility depends on per-item attribution and scope gates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design and code review tally changes for per-item bonus accounting. Focus on co-proposed findings, neutralized proposer restoration, scope drift, and OOS rows. Check that flattened score rows cannot over-award co-proposers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: scoreboard-contract
archetypes.rationale: The feature must not change scoreboard table schemas or pruning math.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the scoreboard rendering and docs for contract stability. Verify columns remain unchanged, the monitoring note is placed below reviewer scoreboards, and pruning or classification logic is not influenced by the bonus. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: env-parser
archetypes.rationale: The feature is off by default and driven by an environment parser.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the environment parser and tests for deterministic off-by-default behavior. Check unset, empty, invalid, zero, negative, and finite positive values, plus formatting of bonus values in user-visible notes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
